content: {"paper_id":"W2648561407","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"Multiple-instance active learning (MIAL) is a paradigm to collect sufficient training bags for a multiple-instance learning (MIL) problem, by selecting and querying the most valuable unlabeled bags iteratively.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"MIAL面向MIL，监督与查询均以包为单位，属于包级/粗粒度弱监督；论文在该弱监督设定下研究多样性主动选择。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"semi-supervised-learning","reason_zh":"摘要表明是主动学习并涉及未标注包，但未说明将未标注样本用于半监督训练；主动学习与半监督学习不等同，证据不足。"}],"input_issues":[]}
